title: Chapter 186: Silkworm Knight
content:
Chapter 186: Silkworm Knight

With the help of Wu Qing, Gou Shu returned with honors, and the general who knew about it happened to die, so he also passed the test smoothly, which was considered a meritorious service.

His status in the army was slightly improved, but he still couldn't escape the calculations of others. He was almost assassinated several times. Fortunately, the Zerg biological colonization suit controlled by the Queen of Zerg saved his life.

Gou Shu was cautious after encountering assassinations many times. He pretended to be dead and escaped when he was ambushed. He sneaked back home secretly, only to find out that the news of his death had been reported back, and his unmarried fiancée was immediately taken to the mansion by someone with a reason.

Gou Shu understood the cause and effect as soon as he thought about it. Such things are not uncommon in the Tengu tribe. Because of his identity, he knew about several of them. He didn't expect that such a thing would fall on his head one day.

He and his fiancée had never even met each other. They only had a title, and there was no emotion. His fiancée was not sad because of his death. The two sides were like strangers. He would not do anything just for his fiancée.

But he could not tolerate his dignity being trampled on and losing his life for it. Thinking back to what happened in the past few days, he felt upset and his suppressed emotions finally broke out!

Now he was already a dead man in the eyes of others. He did not meet his family, but decided to do something he had never dared to think of before.

With a sharp weapon in hand, he wanted to kill!

He used the ability of the Zerg biological colonization suit to lurk outside the mansion of the powerful mastermind behind the scenes, waiting for an opportunity.

Just today, he finally waited for the mastermind to go out, and the son of the powerful went out, followed by a large number of people.

Gou Shu used the ability of the Zerg biological colonization suit to change, and his experience as an elite cavalryman of the Tengu tribe, to change into the costume of the mastermind's personal guard and get close to the mastermind.

When he arrived in the downtown area, Gou Shu unexpectedly stabbed the mastermind with a knife, and then took advantage of the chaotic streets and the ability of the Zerg biological colonization suit to run away.

He is being hunted down now. The Tengu tribe has experts. He can run for a while, but he can't escape the search of the Tengu tribe. The name of Tengu is not for nothing.

The Queen of Insects has been paying attention to Gou Shu's situation, so she asked a team of insect knights to come and help him.

The city where Gou Shu is located is a large city of the Tengu tribe, which happens to be the target city of the insect knights.

There is a ready-made conflict, and it depends on whether something can be done.

Wu Qing understood the whole process of the incident and had to sigh that the world of intelligent creatures, no matter what kind of skin it is covered with, its essence has not changed.

Various causes and effects, entangled, various stories, constantly staged, each world is similar.

...

A team of ten insect knights went straight to the Tengu tribe city, very high-profile all the way.

When they arrived at the city, it was already late. When they entered the city, the gate guards of the Tengu tribe had to stop them and ask about their origins.

The two-star insect knight in the lead introduced himself: "We are from the Zerg Great Xia Territory!"

The name of the Zerg has spread throughout the Tengu tribe's sphere of influence. Everyone knows that the Zerg is a newly-entered clan. The combination of the two identities of newly-entered and a clan makes people have to treat it with caution.

The Zerg Knights only had ten people in their group. The guards at the city gate did not make things difficult for them and quickly let them pass.

When the Zerg Knights entered the city, they saw a prosperous scene. Although it was almost night, the city was still very lively.

The small territories in remote locations are relatively closed. The residents in the city are basically equivalent to the lord's personal slaves, and there are very few outsiders.

People from other forces will not go there, and capable people cannot be kept. This is the case in many territories of the alliance.

And the large cities in this world are all built by powerful clans. Although there are lords, the lords are only representatives of the clans. The city belongs to a clan, not to one person.

This kind of city has a large population, and the source is very complicated. There are people from other forces, races, and large territories stationed there, as well as shops of various chambers of commerce, various free organizations similar to human wanderers, and even many refugees with certain abilities.

In addition, these large cities are important supply points in the nearby areas. Passing caravans and people coming and going will come here to rest and replenish supplies.

These people, together with the residents of the city, jointly promote the prosperity of the city.

This is actually similar to the ancient human cities that Wu Qing knows, and it is even more prosperous.

Ten insect knights entered the city and headed straight for Gou Shu's hiding place according to the positioning of the insect biological colonization suit.

Gou Shu's situation is not good now. The Tengu tribe has a very sensitive nose, and there are masters who are responsible for searching and tracking. They have practiced the secret method of tracking. They can always find Gou Shu's hiding place based on the faint breath left by Gou Shu.

Even with the assistance of the insect biological colonization suit, Gou Shu can't get rid of the tracking of the Tengu tribe.

Ten insect knights rode on insect war horses and galloped on the main road in the city, quickly approaching Gou Shu's position. When they were nearby, they left the main road and went around to a residential area full of houses.

The main intersections of this residential area were all blocked by well-equipped Tengu troops. The Tengu tracking personnel had locked the approximate location of Gou Shu.

There were Tengu troops searching in the houses in the blockade area. They were rude, breaking down doors and cabinets, causing chaos.

Ten insect knights rushed over and rushed in front of the Tengu troops responsible for the blockade, which made the Tengu troops alert.

"Who is coming!"

"Please stop!"

The Tengu army responsible for the blockade stopped the Bug Knights.

"We are the Celestial Silkworm Knights of the Zerg Bactria!"

"By the Lord's order! Join the world to inherit the skills! Select talents!"

"We must contribute our little strength to the counterattack against the Evil God camp!"

The leading two-star insect knight announced his identity and purpose of coming here with a voice like rolling thunder.

The reason why he behaves like this is because the Tengu Clan’s search caused a lot of noise, and there were a lot of onlookers around. In addition to the residents who were blocked in the residential area, a large number of people gathered here, which was exactly what was advertised. Good timing.

As soon as these words were shouted out, the level and height went up.

The Silkworm Knights were the names Wu Qing had just given to these insect knights. This name was not something he came up with yet, but when the insect knights were galloping on their horses, he occasionally heard someone say: "Zerg Cecilia? Zerg. Have you ever heard of the Celestial Silkworm Knights? Look at their momentum, they are a powerful force!”

Wu Qing was observing the situation in the city through the Insect Knight, and when he heard the name of the Celestial Silkworm Knight, he felt very good about it, so he used the name.

The insect knights, officially named the Celestial Silkworm Knights by Wu Qing, had just passed through the city, and many people noticed them. This shows that Wu Qing's high-profile strategy is very effective.

The Tengu army responsible for sealing off the residential area softened their tone when they heard that the people coming were from the Zerg tribe, because they had orders from above to try not to conflict with the Zerg tribe.

"Dear Silkworm Knights of the Zerg Tribe, we are searching for serious criminals. If you want to pass, please wait a moment!"

Although these Tengu tribe soldiers have heard some of the reputation of the Zerg tribe, they don't care. The Tengu tribe is the real overlord of this area. They are the soldiers of the overlord, so of course they are a little arrogant.

"We have received news that a friend of our lord is in this blockade area. We are going to bring him out!"

Said the leader of the Celestial Silkworm Knight Squadron.

"What race is the noble lord's friend? What's his name? We can help call him out!"

That day, the person in charge of the dog army thought for a moment and did not embarrass the Zerg's Celestial Silkworm Knight.

"His name is Gou Shu, a member of the Tengu tribe!"

The squad leader of the Celestial Silkworm Cavalry answered truthfully.

"The Tengu clan wants to tell you?"

That day, the person in charge of the Dog Clan felt that the name sounded familiar, but couldn't remember who it was for the moment, so he sent an order to have someone go to the blockade area to call out the Tengu Clan member named Gou Shu.

"Who is the Tengu Clan Gou Shu? The Lord of the Zerg Clan has sent people to find you! Come out quickly!"

When the order was passed to the search troops, soldiers with loud voices shouted.

Gou Shu, who was hiding in the dark and preparing to fight to the death, suddenly heard someone calling his name. He thought his identity was exposed and was shocked.

But when he learned that the lord of the Zerg tribe had sent people to look for him, he thought of Wu Qing, who had given him the Zerg biological reproductive equipment. It was this biological equipment that saved him from danger many times.

He is not afraid of death. What he is afraid of is that after his death, his identity will be exposed and his family will be affected.

Now he has no way to escape, and his identity is inevitable. This sudden change may be the only way out. He can only take a gamble.

Gou Shu turned the Zerg creature's reproductive equipment into a body-covering armor, tried his best to cover up his aura, put away his weapons, and walked out of the hidden house empty-handed.

"I'm just lying!"

Gou Shu agreed proactively.

His appearance aroused the vigilance of the searching soldiers, but because this was the person they were looking for, the soldiers didn't do anything else and took Gou Shu to the blocked intersection where the Celestial Silkworm Knight was.

As soon as the Celestial Silkworm Knight saw the Zerg creature's reproductive attire, he knew that the person coming was Gou Shu, and shouted to Gou Shu: "Gou Shu, the lord wants to see you for something, come here!"

When Gou Shu saw the Celestial Silkworm Knight, he thought of the personal guards following Wu Qing. Although the equipment was slightly different, the feeling was the same.

"It turns out that the Lord's personal guards are here! I'll come over right now!"

Gou Shu didn't say much and quickly walked past the Tengu army on a blockade mission.

"stop!"

A person next to the person in charge of the blockade suddenly shouted to Gou Shu.

"You are the one who carried out the sneak attack! It turns out that this matter is also related to the Zerg!"

"Get them!"

This man seemed to have a high status. He gave the order directly, and the surrounding Tengu soldiers immediately surrounded Gou Shu and the Tiancan Knight.

"Do you still want to fight against my Zerg tribe? But you need to think clearly!"

The captain of the Celestial Silkworm Knights warned.
